To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) regional energy resource integration and cooperation in GMS would improve energy security and reduce the total-regions energy systems cost by up to 18%, (2) an individual CO2 emission reduction target for each country would be more costly than the joint CO2 reduction strategy, and (3) the joint CO2 emissions reduction strategy would improve energy security in the region.

the regional energy resource development and integration would be beneficial to all the five countries of GMS in terms of energy security and environmental quality, but it is not the case for Myanmar.

the regional energy resource development and CO2 emissions constraint in the GMS would reduce the energy system costs, improve the energy security, increase the energy efficiency and abate the CO2 emissions.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following issues: (i) the impacts of energy resource development on energy systems costs, energy supply mix, and environmental quality, and (ii) the impacts of joint energy resource development and joint CO2 emission control on energy systems costs and environmental quality in the GMS.
the regional energy resource development, energy system cost and energy security under the CO2 emission constraint within the GMS.
energy resource development and CO2 emission reduction in the five GMS.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

regional energy resource development would benefit energy systems in all the study countries, but the benefits of such development are subject to the level of regional energy resource trade, energy demand growth and the level of CO2 emission constraint.
the energy security and environment would be improved by the regional energy resource integration and trade under the CO2 emission constraint.
the regional energy resource development and integration would improve energy security, lower energy systems costs, and reduce CO2 emissions of the GMS.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
regional energy resource development and integration would improve energy security, lower energy systems cost and enhance environment in the GMS.
the GMS countries would benefit from the regional energy resource integration, and the benefits would be further enhanced by a coordinated CO2 emission reduction policy.
the GMS countries should take into account the benefits of regional energy resources integration and trade for their sustainable economic growth and environmental quality improvement.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the regional energy resource integration and development would help to reduce the energy systems cost, improve the regional energy security and enhance the environmental quality.
the energy resource development in GMS countries should not only focus on energy security and economic development but also consider environmental sustainability.
the regional cooperation in energy resource development and power trade can bring about substantial energy cost reduction and environmental benefits.
